sources.snippet: All open-weight Qwen 3 models are Apache 2.0 (free commercial use), span 0.6B to 235B parameters across 119 languages, and support a toggleable thinking mode. The newer flagship Qwen3.7-Max (May 2026) is API-only with no open weights, so it cannot run locally.
